copy.html:
Here at LottosOnline, we would like to reward all our players for playing online with us through our VIP Rewards Program.

Spend €50 or more within a 30 day period on LottosOnline and you qualify for VIP player status! Your VIP status will remain as long as you have spent €50 or more in the previous 30 day period from the current date.

How do I Receive VIP Player Status?

Every time you spend €50 or more within a 30 day period on LottosOnline, you will qualify for VIP player status. For the next 30 days you will receive 10% cash back on all your future purchases!

That's right, no matter how many, how large, or how small your purchases are, for the next 30 days you will get 10% cash back in your LottosOnline Rewards Balance!

What Happens at the end of the 30 Day Period?

If over the next 30 days once you have qualified for VIP player status, you do not spend a further €50 or more, then your 10% cash back will expire.

If over the next 30 days you spend €50 or more again, then as soon as you purchase €50 worth of tickets, your VIP player status is rolled over immediately for an additional 30 days and you will continue to receive 10% cash back in your LottosOnline Rewards Balance!

Simply put, the more you play, the more you reap the rewards!

It's easy to become a VIP player at LottosOnline. We want to reward our loyal players with the best opportunity of winning the jackpot prizes and help them make the most of their ticket purchases.

So what are you waiting for? Stop dreaming, and start playing!

Start Playing!
